top_concerns: Sparsity analysis characterizes the empirical-optimum posterior mean, not the trained network; no evidence that networks fail to generalize or memorize, and the memorization/generalization literature is ignored
The degradation statistic is near-tautological (nearest training point to its own noised version in high dimension) and the equations contain errors (inverse-distance weights, p(x0) misuse)
Natural Inference unification is algebraically trivial (linear multistep unrolling) and only approximately/numerically verified; novelty over DEIS/UniPC-style views is unclear
Section 5 explanations (high-order speedups, CFG robustness, sharpness, over-enhancement) rest on single qualitative examples without ablations or metrics
Only CIFAR-10 FID at 3 step counts with hand-tuned matrices and weak baselines; no comparison with UniPC or learned-solver methods; optimization procedure unspecified
